# Hugeicons transport paths

The local Play and Pause paths in `../../icons.tsx` come from the official
MIT-licensed `@hugeicons/core-free-icons` package, version **4.2.2**:

- [PlayIcon.js](https://unpkg.com/@hugeicons/core-free-icons@4.2.2/dist/esm/PlayIcon.js)
- [PauseIcon.js](https://unpkg.com/@hugeicons/core-free-icons@4.2.2/dist/esm/PauseIcon.js)
- [Official repository and license](https://github.com/hugeicons/hugeicons)

Adaptation: the closed paths retain their original geometry and use
`fill="currentColor"` with no stroke for Tilt's solid transport controls. They
are derived from the free Stroke Rounded paths, not the licensed Pro Solid
Rounded pack. Other editor icons continue to use the official icon font.

The upstream MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`.
